color.mcp: Cyan identifies discovery and structured tool invocation

shared_visual_core.material: Flat dark technical panels with a subtle grid and restrained glow
shared_visual_core.shape_and_line: Three equal lanes use thin stable borders, straight connectors and compact mechanism drawings
shared_visual_core.image_treatment: The mechanism diagrams are native HTML/CSS; the confirmed original author uses a local project-owned avatar
shared_visual_core.hierarchy_and_rhythm: One Chinese-first title, three parallel mechanism lanes and one shared product-neutral capability rail

static_composition.structure: Each lane explains caller, interface behavior and observable result at the same semantic depth
static_composition.comparison: Lane geometry stays parallel while color and internal mechanism distinguish the three concepts
static_composition.shared_core: A single bottom rail names the general capability that all three interfaces can reach
static_composition.thumbnail: The title and three lane identities remain recognizable at 360px output width
